definitions.gloss: early to bed, early to rise; keeping early hours
definitions.explanation: The habit of going to bed early and waking up early. Considered a virtuous and healthy lifestyle in Japanese culture.

examples.japanese: {早寝早起|はやねはやお}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{心|こころ}がけている→心がける：10015_kokorogakeru⟧。
examples.english: I try to go to bed early and wake up early.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{早寝早起|はやねはやお}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{習慣|しゅうかん}→習慣：01429_shuukan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つけさせたい。
examples.english: I want my children to develop the habit of going to bed early and waking up early.

examples.japanese: {早寝早起|はやねはやお}き⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧もとだ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: It has been said since long ago that early to bed, early to rise is the foundation of good health.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of ⟦{早寝|はやね}→早寝：12994_hayane⟧ (going to bed early) + ⟦{早起|はやお}き→早起き：02477_hayaoki⟧ (waking up early). Used as a noun or suru verb ({早寝早起|はやねはやお}き⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧). A well-known proverb-like expression emphasizing healthy living.

CULTURAL NOTE:
The full proverb is {早寝早起|はやねはやお}き⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{三文|さんもん}→三文：28481_sanmon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{徳|とく}→徳：23014_toku⟧ (early to bed and early to rise brings threefold virtue), equivalent to the English saying "Early to bed and early to rise makes a man healthy, wealthy, and wise."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {早寝早起|はやねはやお}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{習慣|しゅうかん}→習慣：01429_shuukan⟧ (habit of keeping early hours)
- {早寝早起|はやねはやお}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{心|こころ}がける→心がける：10015_kokorogakeru⟧ (to try to keep early hours)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{規則正|きそくただ}しい→規則正しい：20039_kisokutadashii⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧: regular lifestyle — a broader concept of living in a disciplined way
